subject: a button-headed textile artisan sprite
pose: sitting cross-legged with hands resting on knees
requested_medium: textile miniature with luminous stitch accents
art_direction: 纽扣头小角色穿全覆盖拼片工作服，月白缝线与荧橙口袋在靛蓝夜色中显得机灵细致。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a small textile artisan sprite with a large ivory button for a head and a fully covering indigo patchwork outfit. The four button holes form a simple amused face through their arrangement, without adding human features. Seat the character cross-legged with padded hands resting on the knees and one bright orange pocket on the chest. Fine moon-white stitches trace the seams, with a few teal thread accents that catch light. Use a dark blue background and soft warm illumination from below. Render woven fabric, worn button edges, and uneven hand stitching as tactile details. Keep the figure centered and compact for a circular avatar, with no tools, text, or surrounding sewing objects.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
